page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the High Clock Speed family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The processing tier relies on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The hardware architecture incorporates a 33 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1 data cache per core. Vector and instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and AES, while AMX support is absent.

Memory allocation totals 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a compute-centric 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes with no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. The network configuration provides a baseline bandwidth capacity of 10 Gbps. No dedicated GPUs or complementary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark results situate the ecs.hfc7.8xlarge in the average performance bracket across multiple standardized metrics. Stress-ng delivers a score of 1579.99 for single-core and 33336.85 for multi-core processing, matching a Geekbench score of 1352.0 in single-core and 11856.0 in multi-core tests. Software compilation with Clang achieved 25683.0 points. In memory operations, uncached 256 MB blocks registered 115.09 GB/sec read and 52.5 GB/sec write throughput. CPU-bound machine learning tasks show small 135M model generation rates of 86.67 tokens/sec and medium 7B model generation rates of 11.96 tokens/sec.

From an infrastructure perspective, the ecs.hfc7.8xlarge provides dense compute capacity suited for compute-heavy parallel workloads. Key tradeoffs include the reliance on external network storage for all disk I/O and moderate memory density that excludes extremely large in-memory footprints. The configuration fits workloads such as code compilation, parallel batch compression, CI/CD pipelines, and application web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.8xlarge is a high clock speed, compute-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) based on the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 64.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per core) and a 10 Gbps network bandwidth baseline. The instance includes no local storage or GPUs, relying on network-attached storage. Benchmark profiles place it within middle-tier performance distributions, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 31763.08, a multi-core Geekbench score of 11856.0, and 31.19 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. The system includes AVX-512 instruction set extensions, fitting compute-focused workloads such as multi-threaded software compilation, batch processing, and high-throughput web serving.
